body.x: CIT Co. Ltd., (CEO Seung Jeong) a pioneer in advanced materials, has been honored with the CES 2025 Innovation Award in the Vehicle Tech & Advanced Mobility category for its revolutionary transparent antenna, Dolphin. Inspired by the dolphin's ability to detect a vast range of frequencies, this cutting-edge antenna offers the widest frequency range among transparent antennas, setting a new benchmark in the field.

As the automotive industry evolves with autonomous driving technologies and Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs), the demand for efficient and reliable data transmission has never increased. Existing transparent antennas often fall short in both frequency range and adaptability. Dolphin addresses these limitations by operating across six frequency bands, from L-band to K-band, supporting up to 20 GHz. This makes it an ideal solution for 5G communications, delivering exceptional frequency coverage for connected vehicles surpassing conventional antennas’ capabilities.

Dolphin also embodies innovation in transparency and sustainability. With ultra-thin copper circuits less than 10 nanometers thick—1,000 times thinner than a human hair—the antenna achieves 90% transparency, making it nearly invisible when embedded in car windows or glass surfaces. This sleek and flexible design is unmatched by traditional antennas, which use 5 ~ 10 micrometer-thick circuits. Furthermore, Dolphin is produced using recycled copper wires, reducing its carbon footprint to 1/1000th that of conventional antennas and exemplifying CIT’s commitment to environmentally responsible manufacturing.

Beyond its automotive applications, Dolphin’s potential extends to various sectors, including smart building windows, streetlights, and glass panels for bus stops. CIT has also applied its advanced material technology to develop transparent displays with ultra-thin, invisible copper circuits. These displays provide seamless visual experiences, making them ideal for digital signage, exhibition halls, commercial spaces, and public transportation systems such as buses and trains.

CIT will showcase the Dolphin transparent antenna and its innovative transparent display technology at CES 2025, held in Las Vegas. Attendees can explore these groundbreaking solutions at the Venetian Expo, Booth #50769, and experience how CIT redefines connectivity and transparency.

Founded in 2023, CIT has quickly established itself as a leader in advanced materials, specializing in innovative products such as low-dielectric FCCL (Flexible Copper-Clad Laminate), transparent antennas, and transparent displays. These technologies are transforming industries, including automotive, smart buildings, and AR/VR. Recognized for its excellence, CIT has received multiple prestigious awards, including the FLY ASIA Advanced Manufacturing Award and the Public Technology Commercialization Innovation Award. Through sustainable practices and global collaborations, CIT continues to advance its mission of bringing next-generation technologies to market and becoming a global leader in advanced materials.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
